decisions.reason: Because this collaborative robot loading system builds directly on the firm's established automation and manufacturing know-how, its strong in-house R&D and service capabilities make it likely that management will retain and refine it rather than withdraw it.

As a dual-table loading system closely related to the firm's existing machinery and automation portfolio, it fits the firm's absorptive capacity well and is therefore unlikely to be taken off the market soon.

Although the industrial dispensing machine is more distant from the firm's established knowledge base and thus carries higher withdrawal risk, the firm's own R&D, expansion strategy, and flagship positioning reinforced by a 2024 design award make continued commitment more likely than discontinuation.
